consent-denial-monotone.statement: Deleting a grant, removing a grant_scope, narrowing a clamp verb, or adding a consent_policy row can only turn an allow into a deny, never a deny into an allow.

consent-clamp-order-independent.statement: The decision, the set of returned rowFilter clauses, and the fieldMask are invariant under permutation of identity.scopeClamp.

consent-clamp-only-narrows.statement: For every allow, the returned rowFilter is a superset of the grant scope's and the clamp's clauses, and the fieldMask is exactly grantMask ∩ clampMask (null only when both are null).

consent-reveal-never-rides.statement: Reveal is allowed only when both a grant_scope and a clamp scope carry the 'reveal' verb; a 'reveal' scope never satisfies a read or act request.

consent-explicit-scope-unbypassable.statement: A table under a kind:'minimization' policy row is never allowed by a whole-schema (table_name IS NULL) grant scope; only a scope naming the table explicitly covers it.

consent-onbehalf-cap-precedes-grants.statement: When onBehalfOfOwner.mayAct is false, no grant set produces an allow for act or reveal, and the deny names the owner id, checked before any grant is consulted.

untrusted-display-total.statement: displayText never throws for any input (non-strings included), preserves code-point length and is idempotent for strings, and emits no character in the forbidden C0-control/DEL/bidi-override/bidi-isolate set.

untrusted-url-allowlist-closed.statement: safeExternalUrl/safeMediaUrl/safeDocumentUrl each return null or a value in that function's own scheme allowlist, never matching javascript:/vbscript:/data:text/html/data:image/svg; safeExternalUrl additionally never returns a value carrying a control code unit (<=32 or 127).

untrusted-media-subsumed-by-document.statement: Every value safeMediaUrl accepts, safeDocumentUrl accepts with an identical result; the converse (document accepts, media rejects) occurs only for data:application/pdf and data:text/plain.

untrusted-background-image-unescapable.statement: safeBackgroundImage output is undefined or a single sealed CSS url("…") token whose every quote and backslash is escaped and which recovers exactly the URL the media sink admitted, so no member string can break out of the quoted string.

commons-steward-ordered-convergence.statement: Each Commons grant has one independent monotonic steward sequence; cursor-gapped members converge to the same domain state, and capability downgrades govern commands from their exact stream position onward.

placement-registry-parity.statement: Every placeable blueprint entity is enumerated once and Locker is structurally excluded.

pending-overlay.statement: Every blueprint local read is replica plus durable outbox, with per-action projection declarations and structural exclusions owned by one engine.

custody-seat-exclusion.statement: Record-only blueprint apps never import or render byte-custody machinery.

consent-domain-parity.statement: Blueprint consent surfaces and automation scheduling recognize the same enrichment domains.

triage-session-progress.statement: Proposal queues share frozen progress, distinct skip semantics, and reachable completion.

search-scaffold-grouping.statement: Search entity configuration owns grouping, ordering, caps, and result-state truth.

per-scope-reach.statement: Every mounted scope reports whether search reached it, was offline, or refused the query instead of collapsing those states into no matches.

mask-refuses-not-no-matches.statement: A field-masked search refusal remains a typed refusal through the replica and search-scaffold boundary and is never rendered as an honest empty result.

recognition-self-contained.statement: Blueprint apps, automations, and mobile code use host-owned model seams and never resurrect provider SDKs or deleted inference roads.

provider-egress-dispatch.statement: Outbound provider requests leave centraid only through the ACP dispatch path — runTurn resolving a HARNESSES spec and spawning it via harnessSpawnEnv, downstream of decideEnrichmentGate — never through a provider SDK import, a provider API host literal, or a host-path HTTP client.

one-computation.statement: A pure product-law computation is a projection or a shared module imported by every seat, never two seat-local implementations.

people-photograph-counts.statement: Every seat counts distinct confirmed photographs, not face regions or unconfirmed proposals, and keeps unnamed groups separate.

enrichment-model-lock.statement: Every live-model file and native runtime dependency is immutable by version/digest and its permissive licence is recorded in LICENSES.md.

enrichment-live.statement: Pinned real weights satisfy the advertised capability/model handshake and the committed OCR, embedding, and face-geometry goldens.

backup-round-trip.statement: A restored snapshot reproduces the vault byte-identically — same files, same directory tree, plus the quarantine marker.

backup-incremental.statement: A second snapshot after a small change uploads far fewer chunks than the first, so backup cost tracks change, not vault size.

backup-no-change.statement: A run over an unchanged vault registers nothing and returns null, so an idle machine never mints snapshots.

backup-restore-refusal.statement: Restore refuses a non-empty destination, a newer vaultUserVersion, an unknown format, and a manifest whose hash does not verify — and refuses before fetching or materializing anything.

backup-verify.statement: Verification detects a deleted chunk and a corrupted chunk, and reports a clean snapshot as clean.

share-closure-confinement.statement: A share closure carries only the rows reachable from the items it names — no other row, derivative or blob of the origin vault crosses — and an item the origin does not hold refuses the whole read rather than yielding a partial closure.

share-receipt-authority.statement: A cross-vault access receipt exists exactly when an edge's rows landed at the audience, naming the authorised origin scope and the audience ids created, once per edge; a refused, parked, revoked or peer-handed-off edge leaves none, and a malformed scope refuses the transition atomically.

share-outbox-obligation.statement: Every share obligation is durable and keyed by what it is about: a replayed enqueue reuses the row without rewinding its retry clock, a human-awaiting obligation is never machine-claimed, an unreadable row never blocks its neighbours, and a failed attempt backs off while a progressed transfer does not.

experimental-gate-parity.statement: An experimental feature is advertised in the C1 handshake exactly when its own routes are mounted: gated off it is absent from capabilities and its surfaces are unowned; gated on, and only then, they answer.

insights-rollup-render-or-withhold.statement: Every field of the gateway's insights rollup is rendered on Analytics or withheld on the record with a stated reason; a field that is neither is a silent deletion.

native-block-flag-marks.statement: Every semantic flag the shared block contracts declare produces a mark on the phone that the unflagged form does not — accepting a flag and drawing the ordinary control is not parity.

people-overdue-never.statement: Cadence 0 is Never and never overdue.

people-link-tristate.statement: The link fact is linked, unlinked, or absent — never a false unlinked on a denied share read.

people-roster-sub.statement: A linked roster row's second line leads with Linked, then the role if any.

people-trash-split.statement: Deleted profiles are the trash shelf, not roster rows, and carry purge_at.

people-search-scope.statement: People search covers name, role and notes.

people-avatar-hue.statement: A stored avatar hue round-trips as a wheel key, honours a hex verbatim, and otherwise derives from the party id.

people-link-ring.statement: The avatar ring states the link and only the link: solid when linked, dashed when unlinked, nothing when unknown.

people-row-marks.statement: The People row's meta takes net only as a consequence of being overdue.

people-star-a11y.statement: The star names its person and its direction.

people-readonly-star.statement: A person in a read-only source withholds the star: the press is refused instead of letting the write throw, the control reports itself disabled and carries the reason, and it still names Star or Unstar.

people-row-pending.statement: A queued People change says so on its own row: the overlay sentence is a third line under the sub, and a row with no pending change draws no pending line at all.

consentLedger.note: The closed deny set every seat inherits; the contract suite exercises it, no generated denial sweep does.

consentLedger.label: App scope manifests
consentLedger.note: The G4 sweep landed (#839): manifest-scope-denial.{sweep,closed-grammar,fuzz} drive the real validateManifest + parseManifest + evaluateConsent over all 37 bundled manifests — every declared scope×verb allows, every undeclared combination denies closed inside the six DENY_CLASSES, and property fuzz holds. #864 M5 adds manifest-scope-denial.hostile: synthetic third-party/attacker manifests built in memory and pushed through the real validators — case, NFKC, whitespace and __proto__/constructor name variants and a 10000-scope list deny as manifest-undeclared, and the validator layer refuses malformed shapes (a garbage rowFilter op the app schema waves through is rejected by the automation validator). Open hole characterized by test.fails + a filed note: the app manifest validator types rowFilter.op as a bare string and executionClamp carries rowFilter/fieldMask contents opaquely, so a structurally-invalid clause reaches ALLOW and is refused only as a bare throw at filters.ts compile, outside the receipt grammar.
